title: Code and list
narration: The densest board the core renderer must handle starts with fourteen lines of code in two columns of cells and a six item list whose items each run to eight words, side by side.

lines: // 14 lines, 44 chars max per line here

items: Receive the request and normalise every header
Derive the cache key from the url body
Look the key up in the response store
Serve the hit when it is still fresh
Otherwise compute the answer and store it
Return the response to the waiting client
